modes.label: Single ticket
modes.note: Percentages apply to the fare paid for that one journey, measured by the delay at your destination station.

modes.label: Travel card, regional
modes.capNote: Total capped at 25 percent of the card's value. Cases from 20 minutes may be bundled into one claim.
modes.note: There is no single-journey price on a travel card, so DB pays a flat amount per delayed journey.

modes.label: Travel card, long-distance
modes.capNote: Total capped at 25 percent of the card's value.
modes.note: Second class. First class pays 7.50 euros per case.

modes.label: Berlin U-Bahn, tram, bus
modes.note: More than 20 minutes late through BVG's own fault earns a free ticket, not money. A taxi between 23:00 and 05:00 is reimbursed up to 25 euros. Claim within 14 days.
